policy.title: Privacy Policy
policy.intro: Thana Glass Group takes the protection of your personal data seriously and handles it in accordance with Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (PDPA).

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Your first and last name, phone number, email address and LINE ID. If you request a company tax invoice we also collect your company name, tax ID and company address, along with the list of products you selected.

sections.heading: Why we use it
sections.body: Solely to prepare and deliver your quotation, contact you about further details, issue tax documents, and provide the services you requested. We do not use your data for marketing without your consent.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We retain quotation requests for as long as our business needs and Thai accounting and tax law require. After that period the data is deleted or anonymised.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
sections.body: We never sell or trade your personal data. It may be disclosed only as necessary to affiliated companies, delivery providers, or government agencies where required by law.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, a copy of, correction of, deletion of, or suspension of the use of your data, object to its processing, and withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing already carried out.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: To exercise these rights or ask about data protection, please reach our team through any of the channels listed on our contact page.
